text: Six bottles of Brown Ale sit on a shelf. You drink two, then buy three more. How many are on the shelf now?
Sausage rolls are 90p each. How many can you buy with a £5 note?
A quiz has 8 rounds of 10 questions, and you get 7 right in every round. What's your total?
Quiz night is a Saturday. What day of the week was it ten days before?
why: Seven days back is Saturday again; three more is Wednesday.

text: A Metro leaves every 12 minutes, starting at 7:00. At what time does the fifth one leave?
Using only 1p, 2p and 5p pieces, count the different combinations totalling exactly 10p.
why: With no 5p: 6 ways; with one 5p: 3 ways; with two 5p: 1 way.
